name: Wang Ning
bio: Wang Ning (王柠) is a Chinese actress formerly known as 王宁.

credits.title: Just a Joke
credits.overview: Ji Hong, a sanitation worker, is desperate to secure a school enrollment spot for her child. She finds herself subjected to inappropriate advances disguised as "jokes" by her supervisor at work. While her colleagues turn a blind eye to such behavior, the stubborn Ji Hong resolves to fight back.

credits.title: Georgia
credits.overview: After three-year-old Georgia accidentally gets lost, she encounters a boy deprived of familial warmth due to his parents’ divorce. Her purity, kindness, and love empower him to face reality with courage, while also helping her own family—on the brink of collapse—regain warmth.

credits.title: All in All 4 You
credits.overview: A group of students trained in the special school for the art college entrance examination.

credits.title: An Elephant Sitting Still
credits.overview: In the northern Chinese city of Manzhouli, they say there is an elephant that simply sits and ignores the world. Manzhouli becomes an obsession for the protagonists of this film, a longed-for escape from the downward spiral in which they find themselves.

credits.title: Spring Subway
credits.overview: A stylish urban romance about the silent suffering of a modern Chinese couple.

credits.title: Love Will Tear Us Apart
credits.overview: The film gets under the skin of a very marginalized group: recent immigrants to Hong Kong from Mainland China.
